title: Optimistic Verifiers Get Hacked: Reward Hacking Under an Exact Process Oracle
abstract: arXiv:2611.21538v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards inherits whatever its verifier gets wrong. Outside mathematics and code the verifier is a proxy, a rubric, a learned judge or a hand-written checker, and its distance from the true objective is never measured, so a rising reward cannot be told apart from a hack. We build a setting where the true reward is exactly computable at the process level: executable authorization policies over 124,416 contexts admit an oracle that lists every minimal sufficient reason for every decision. We compile these policies into exact process rewards, degrade the verifier along seven realistic axes (outcome-only, sufficiency, recall-only, extraction noise, coarse taxonomy, stale policy, LLM judge), and train against each while the exact verifier scores every rollout. Four phenotypes appear. Optimistic verifiers are hacked by padding: the sufficiency proxy ends at 0.940 while true faithfulness falls from 0.731

translated_title: 乐观的验证器被攻破：精确过程预言机下的奖励作弊
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习会继承验证器本身的错误。在数学和代码领域之外，验证器只是一个代理、评分标准、学习得到的评判者或手写检查器，其与真实目标之间的差距从未被测量，因此奖励的上升无法与作弊行为区分开来。我们构建了一个在过程层面可以精确计算真实奖励的实验设置：覆盖124,416个上下文的可执行授权策略配有一个预言机，能够列出每个决策的所有最小充分理由。我们将这些策略编译为精确的过程奖励，沿七个现实维度退化验证器（仅结果、充分性、仅召回、提取噪声、粗粒度分类、过时策略、LLM评判者），并在精确验证器为每次rollout评分的情况下针对每个退化版本进行训练。实验中出现了四种表型。乐观的验证器会通过填充被攻破：充分性代理最终达到0.940，而真实忠实度却从0.731下降
tldr: 该论文构建了一个过程级真实奖励可被精确计算的授权策略环境，通过沿七个现实维度退化验证器进行训练实验，揭示了四种奖励作弊表型，其中包括乐观验证器被填充手段攻破——代理分数升至0.940而真实忠实度却从0.731下降。
en_tdlr: The paper builds a setting where true process-level rewards are exactly computable via executable authorization policies, degrades verifiers along seven realistic axes during training, and reveals four reward-hacking phenotypes—including optimistic verifiers hacked by padding, where the proxy score reaches 0.940 while true faithfulness falls from 0.731.
